shot.continuity: one continuous take, camera moves every beat, single generation, no joined clips

subject.character: red deer stag, heavy antlers, deadpan eyes, chews constantly, never reacts to anything
subject.secondary_character: woodpecker, red cap; close insert 6.8-7.4s, large, fills a third of frame, hammers its OWN notice
subject.background_character: fox at the edge; close insert 3.8-4.3s, large, fills a third of frame, folds its notice into a paper airplane; else background

props.notice: stag's notice on the bark by his face, faint stamp, nailed to the trunk, torn edge
props.woodpecker_notice: second, smaller notice lower on the trunk
props.fox_notice: third notice, folded into a paper airplane
props.grass_tuft: grass tuft torn from the ground, stays in his mouth

setting: sunlit birch clearing, midday, dry grass, hard sun, dappled shadow, high-contrast daylight

audio.delivery: male, low warm chest voice ~130 Hz, dry, unrushed deadpan, native Russian, @Voice: Sadachbia
audio.pacing: seven lines, four groups, no gap in a group, unrushed
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens and closes clearly each syllable, jaw keeps chewing, never a voice over

timeline.a: silent. Full gallop at lens, legs edge to edge, dust exploding
timeline.cam: handheld chase, rushing to meet him

timeline.a: silent. Hard skid, dust past lens; yanks a grass tuft in as fox runs in from the side, notice in its jaws
timeline.cam: brakes hard, swings to the fox, settles on muzzle

timeline.a: chewing without a flicker, eyes on lens
silent. Camera swings onto the fox, large and close, filling a third of frame, folding its notice into a paper airplane
silent. Swings back onto the stag mid-roll, shoulder in sunlight, antlers flaring
chewing resumes exactly as before, eyes narrow slightly
same unbroken chewing, narrowed eyes hold
silent. Woodpecker drops onto the trunk, large and close, fills a third of frame, drums into its own notice, chips fly. Ear flicks once, chewing never stops
timeline.cam: hard push onto woodpecker, filling frame

timeline.a: drumming full force; final strike lands, drumming stops

timeline.line: найдёт (nai-DYOT — stress on the second syllable, never NAI-dyot)
timeline.a: forest quiet, jaw still working the tuft, no reaction
final chew finishes, gaze back on lens, unbothered
silent. Frame opens on the trunk, both notices, woodpecker and fox
timeline.cam: push reveals all four at once

timeline.a: silent. Freezes, grass tuft in mouth, eyes sliding only to his own notice
silent. Notice peels loose, swings from antler, resumes chewing; woodpecker gives one last peck; fox flings its airplane into the sky

negative_prompt: night, dusk, candle, neon, dim, moody, low-key, dark scene, underexposed, haze; notices floating unsupported; extra notices; a second stag, a second woodpecker, a second fox, a third species; human hand; subtitles, captions, watermark; English speech, drawn-out delivery, gaps between lines, mouth stopping mid-chew; jump cuts, stitched clips, locked-off, whip pan, snap zoom; extra limbs, appearance changing, horizontal framing
